5 pounds cracked corn.

3 pounds malted barley.

1 Tablespoon amalayse extract.

1 Packet Redstar Champagne yeast

5 Gallons of water.

Start by putting two gallons of water in a large stockpot and get up to about 110 degrees F.

Add all cracked corn and hold steady while stirring for about 10 minutes.

Kill heat and let the heat drop to 100F.

Add amalayse extract and stir.

Move to a seal-able container and let sit for two days. The amalayse will start breaking down the starches into sugar and it will smell like sweet and sour corn.

Put back in stockpot, add one gallon of water and heat up to 130F and stir constantly while adding in portions of your malted barley.

Put the remaining 2 gallons of water in your fermentation vessel and when you are doing that activate your yeast packet in 3 ounces of water that is 90-95F

Dump everything in your stockpot into your fermentation vessel, stir, check your temperature, when it is around 90-95 degrees add yeast starter and airlock.

Wait one to two weeks until yeast is not active or barely active.

Filter through metal mesh or paper filter.

Run it low and slow.
